objectives: “This course aims at introducing stochastic modeling, with a focus on Markov chain, Poisson processes, renewal theory, branching process, queuing system, and their applications.“
content:
“- Introduction
- Conditional probability and conditional expectation
- Markov chains
- Poisson processes
- Continuous time Markov chains
- Renewal phenomena, Queuing theory, reliability theory
- Brownian motion and stationary process
- Simulation“
books:
“Textbook
Ross, S. (2010) Introduction to Probability models, 11th Edition, Elsevier Taiwan LLC, Taipei.“
